svg.title: Localswim V2 milestone workstreams
svg.desc: All 39 milestones are placed by their complete documented prerequisite graph. Each target sits below every prerequisite. Solid arrows show within-workstream order. Dashed arrows show cross-workstream dependencies. Row positions are relative turns, and independent branches may advance as soon as ready.
svg.text: Start after every incoming prerequisite. Independent milestones on the same row can run in parallel.

svg.text: Every 3 hours, demo the milestones that landed on the integrated build.
Rows show prerequisite order. Branches advance independently as soon as their incoming dependencies land.
